claims.claim: Three network devices registered to a Canadian telecommunications company were compromised in mid-February 2025.
claims.support_note: Passage states three network devices registered to a Canadian telecommunications company were compromised by likely Salt Typhoon actors in mid-February 2025.

claims.claim: The actors exploited CVE-2023-20198 to retrieve running configuration files from all three compromised devices.
claims.support_note: Passage directly states the actors exploited CVE-2023-20198 to retrieve the running configuration files from all three devices.

claims.claim: The actors modified at least one configuration file to configure a GRE tunnel enabling traffic collection from the network.
claims.support_note: Passage states the actors modified at least one of the files to configure a GRE tunnel, enabling traffic collection from the network.

claims.claim: The responsible actors are almost certainly PRC state-sponsored actors, specifically Salt Typhoon.
claims.support_note: Passage assesses that the responsible actors are almost certainly PRC state-sponsored actors, specifically Salt Typhoon.

claims.claim: PRC cyber actors are targeting network devices and exploiting existing vulnerabilities to gain and maintain access to telecommunications service providers.
claims.support_note: Passage states that as part of this campaign, PRC cyber actors are targeting these network devices, exploiting existing vulnerabilities to gain and maintain access to TSPs.
